settings.name: Mark
settings.title: A dream come true
settings.body: I’m a West Ham fan and it was my dream to get this cup. The size and detail are spot on. I will treasure it.

settings.name: James T.
settings.title: Incredible detail for a 1:1 replica
settings.body: Ordered this as a surprise for my dad, a lifelong football fan. The size and finish are stunning, and engraving our family name on it made it really personal. It now has pride of place in his study.

settings.name: Daniel O.
settings.title: Exactly like the trophy on TV
settings.body: I was nervous ordering something this big online, but it arrived perfectly packed and looks identical to the cup I've seen lifted on TV. Communication throughout was excellent.

settings.hero_desc: A detailed scale model of an industrial facility - warehouses, administration block, storage tanks and labelled process areas, LED-lit and landscaped on a branded base. A commanding boardroom and exhibition centrepiece.
settings.perso_placeholder: Your facility, labels, branding and lighting
settings.s1_body: A working plant is hard to grasp from drawings. This facility model lays the whole site out to scale - warehouses, offices, tanks, roads and landscaping - with key areas labelled and LED lighting bringing it to life. Built from your plans and finished on a branded base, it's the centrepiece for boardrooms, investor pitches and exhibition stands.
settings.case_body: Built to present a starch manufacturing facility for Oren Hydrocarbon, this model impressed all their visitors and made explaining their factory easier.
settings.case_quote: It explains our entire facility in one glance. Visitors get impressed when they see this.
settings.prov_p: A facility laid out, labelled and lit turns a technical site plan into instant understanding - and confidence in the operation behind it.
